lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Karen, it's Tanya from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. I haven't been sleeping.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So last time your goal was to cook at home 5 nights. How did that go?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It didn't happen this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: The research is very clear, you have to eat earlier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: By 10 o'clock I'm starving.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: The fast feels doable until the evening, and then the hunger takes over.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Black coffee, tea or water are fine during the fast. They don't break it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the cooking at home fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Everybody gets home late, so dinner is late.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the cooking at home going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Next week I want you to finish eating by 7:30 on 3 nights.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 5. Maybe 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll eat a bigger lunch so I'm not starving at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 0 out of 5 days, the hard part was finding the time, and next week you're going to finish eating by 7:30 on 3 nights. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Karen, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Tanya. Bye!

tags.note: Poor sleep and rough week; not acute.
Appeals to research authority; pushes without permission.
Expresses need to act, fear of recurrence.
Hunger after 10pm is a barrier to change.
Will set alarm; surprised she likes it.
Directive right after change talk; not collaborative.
Need to lower blood sugar; cites doctor.
Late household schedule is a barrier.
Commits to cooking at home this week.
Sets goal for her without collaboration.
Plans bigger lunch to avoid night hunger.
Requests later time; coach did not address.

flags.reason: Cites research authority and tells participant what to do; pushes without permission after participant said 'Maybe.'
Directive 'You have to make this a priority' right after participant's change talk at line 21.
Fear-based warning about health suffering; increases resistance rather than exploring her own reasons.
Participant reported a rough week and poor sleep; coach said 'Right' and moved on without exploring.
Participant asked for a later time due to an appointment; coach ignored the request and closed without confirming a time.

score.summary: The coach reviewed the prior goal, set a new goal, and summarized, but repeatedly used persuasion and directives (research citations, warnings, 'you have to') that undercut the participant's change talk. Poor sleep and the late appointment request went unaddressed, which weakened the partnership.
strengths: Line 14: affirmed Karen's honesty with herself.
Line 38 and 40: reflected Karen's commitment to follow through, which surfaced the Monday/Wednesday/Friday plan at line 39.
Line 46 and 48: asked about barriers and summarized the plan clearly, giving Karen a chance to correct it.
coaching_tips: Line 22 and 34: replace 'You have to' and warnings with an open question such as 'What would make this feel possible for you?'
Line 12 and 42: ask permission before giving information, and build the 7:30 goal together with Karen rather than assigning it.
Line 6: reflect the poor sleep and ask how it is affecting her week before moving on.
Line 51: address the appointment request by offering a time choice and confirming next contact.
